Declaration

The entries in this log book are a true record of the testing, servicing and events carried out on the fire detection and fire alarm system at the premises named above. This record is maintained digitally in accordance with {{ standard_edition | default: "BS 5839-1:2025" }} Clause 48.2, is kept available to the responsible person, and can be produced on demand for inspection by an enforcing authority.
